type: reality audit of the surviving Diósi-Penrose parameter territory; no rescoring, no viability declaration

sources.ref: Donadi, Piscicchia, Curceanu, Diósi, Laubenstein, Bassi, Nat. Phys. 17, 74 (2021), arXiv:2111.13490
sources.claim: Gran Sasso underground radiation test: lower bound on effective size of nucleon mass density ~3 orders above previous bounds; 'rules out the natural parameter-free version of the Diósi-Penrose model'

sources.ref: Carlesso, Diósi, Bassi et al., 'On the effectiveness of the collapse in the Diósi-Penrose model', New J. Phys. 26, 113004 (2024), arXiv:2406.18494
sources.claim: Search for an upper bound from the requirement that collapse guarantees classicality at macroscopic scale: 'not all macroscopic systems collapse effectively'; a reasonable (to some degree arbitrary) bound is R0 <~ 10^6 Angstrom (= 0.1 mm)

sources.ref: Bassi et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 85, 471 (2013)
sources.claim: Review: strongest indirect bounds come from Brownian-like diffusion induced by collapse; prior bounds from gravitational-wave detectors, neutron-star heating, cryogenics heat leakage
Heuristic collapse time tau ~ hbar/E_G from gravitational self-energy difference
sources.status: PRIMARY (heuristic, never derived from a gravitational field equation)

model_setup.dp_master_equation_nonunitary_term: D[rho] = -(4 pi G / hbar) * integral d r d r' (1/|r-r'|) [mu(r'), [mu(r), rho(t)]]  [S2, Eq. (2)]
model_setup.mass_density_operator: Gaussian-smeared mass density with effective radius Reff = sqrt(R0^2 + R_i^2); R0 is the ONLY free parameter of the model [S2, Eq. (3)]
model_setup.collapse_time: tau ~ hbar / E_G, E_G = gravitational self-energy of the difference between the two superposed mass distributions [S4]

lower_bound.applies_to: nucleon mass-density effective size; excludes natural parameter-free DP (R0 ~ nuclear size ~ 1e-15 m) by ~5 orders of magnitude

upper_bound.caveat: NOT an empirical bound; derived from the demand that collapse be effective enough to suppress macroscopic superpositions. Explicitly flagged 'to some degree arbitrary'. If relaxed, this bound weakens. Classification: CONSISTENCY_CONSTRAINT, not data-driven exclusion.
upper_bound.applies_to: all DP variants that claim to solve the measurement problem for ordinary macroscopic objects

prior_indirect_bounds.description: earlier, weaker lower bounds on R0 from gravitational-wave-detector data, neutron-star heating, cryostat heat leakage — all indirect Brownian-diffusion effects
prior_indirect_bounds.status: SUPERSEDED by S1 for nucleons (~3 orders stronger)

parameter_space.surviving_window: R0 in [4e-10 m, 1e-4 m] — roughly 6 orders of magnitude of experimentally non-excluded territory, IF the effectiveness upper bound is accepted
parameter_space.window_class: PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED — the lower edge is data-driven; the upper edge is a theoretical demand, not data

gates.parameter_viability: OPEN — 6-order window survives; natural value dead
gates.internal_consistency: CONDITIONAL — finite-R0 mass-density resolution remains CONJECTURE (2013); R0 is an added free parameter; tau ~ hbar/E_G heuristic never derived from a field equation; the stochastic law itself is postulated, so 'why this law' is relocated not answered
gates.experimental_distinguishability: PARTIAL — DP predicts spontaneous radiation from charged macroscopic bodies and loss of interferometric visibility with characteristic E_G scaling distinguishable from Gamma_env (environmental decoherence) in principle; degeneracy with thermal/environmental noise is the dominant practical confound at current sensitivities. Distinguishing observables: (a) spontaneous X/photon emission rate scaling with mass distribution; (b) interferometer visibility loss vs superposition separation with collapse time tau_C saturating at E_G saturation (e.g. osmium-crystal Talbot-Lau proposal, tau_C ~ 1334 s at M = 5.6e-18 kg); (c) radiation vs temperature-independence signature
gates.explanatory_accounting: UNCHANGED from frozen audit — DP buys outcome definiteness + Born-weight operational measure + gravitational linkage; costs: postulated stochastic dynamics, R0 free parameter, undischarged 'why this law', natural version excluded. Postulated collapse != derived outcome selection. Parameterized falsifiability != parameter-free prediction.

predictions_discriminator.parameter_free_prediction: NONE REMAINING — the only parameter-free instantiation (R0 = nuclear size) is empirically excluded [S1]
predictions_discriminator.parameterized_prediction: For each R0 in the surviving window: definite collapse timescale tau(R0, E_G), spontaneous radiation rate, interferometric visibility curve. These are quantitative and falsifiable per-R0 but do not constitute a single parameter-free discriminating prediction.
predictions_discriminator.compression_score_effect: NOT RESCORED per authorization. Note only: compression advantage depends on treating DP's falsifiable structure as evidence of explanatory content, which now applies only to the 6-order window, not the natural theory.

verdict_scope.dp_viable_globally: NOT DECLARED (out of scope per dispatch)
verdict_scope.surviving_territory: YES — a finite, two-sided window [4 A, 1e6 A] with concrete experimental signatures exists
verdict_scope.territory_quality: MIXED — lower edge solid (data), upper edge soft (effectiveness demand); natural theory dead; finite-R0 repair conjectural; distinctness from environmental decoherence is the critical open requirement for every surviving variant

next_exp_tests_ranked.test: Improved underground spontaneous-radiation searches extending the Donadi et al. method
next_exp_tests_ranked.reason: direct extension of the existing exclusion technology; pushes lower bound further and could exclude more of the window

next_exp_tests_ranked.reason: direct superposition-lifetime measurement, E_G scaling distinguishable from decoherence if thermal control adequate
increasingly sensitive but confounded by environmental decoherence; distinguishing power depends on control of Gamma_env
